summary: Frontend-only Expo web preview testing for ENJUV Dinâmicas card app. Verified all 3 decks (12-15, 16-20, 21-30) end-to-end on mobile viewport 420x844. All 11 scoped behaviours working: home deck buttons render with correct testIDs, deck screen opens with correct labels and total=13, 16-20 deck is NOT empty and contains the required Progenitores and Amor Próprio questions, initial state shows 'Toca para revelar', tapping reveals card-question-state with card-question-text, progress pill updates X/13 after each tap, no-repeat logic produced 13 unique questions for every deck, 14th tap shows deck-exhausted-message with reset + home buttons, reset returns to 0/13 initial state, home button and back button both navigate to home. All 28 assertions passed.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'useNativeDriver is not supported... Falling back to JS-based animation.' Expected on web preview; animations still run. Non-blocking.
Console warning: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' Non-blocking cosmetic deprecation on react-native-web.

critical_code_review_comments: deck/[id].tsx handleTap/handleArea logic is correct: last card is revealed, and the subsequent tap transitions to exhausted state (verified with 14 taps = 13 questions + exhausted screen).
shuffle() uses Fisher-Yates correctly; no-repeat guarantee is enforced via queue pop rather than random-with-history, which is the safer approach.
Minor: consider replacing shadow* styles with boxShadow for RN 0.76+ on web to remove console warnings (cosmetic).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully offline - no backend. Use viewport 420x844. Selectors use data-testid. All 13 questions per deck verified for 12-15, 16-20, 21-30. Tapping 13 times yields 13 unique questions; 14th tap triggers exhausted state. Reset/back/home navigation all verified.
